content_metadata.description: An exploration of Mariana Csonger's political campaign and the role of the Two-Tailed Dog Party in Hungarian politics.

qAndA.answer: The Jászberény railway station is the center of Mariana's political district, making it a strategic location for signature collection.
qAndA.question: Why is Mariana collecting signatures at the Jászberény railway station?

qAndA.answer: The symbol is the logo of the Two-Tailed Dog Party, depicting a dog with two tails. It was inspired by an archaeological find in Szeged and reflects the party's use of humor and satire in politics.
qAndA.question: What is the symbol on Mariana's vest, and what is its significance?

qAndA.answer: The Two-Tailed Dog Party's presence makes it easier for Mariana to collect signatures, as the party's popularity and satirical approach help reduce fear and intimidation from the government.
qAndA.question: How does the Two-Tailed Dog Party's involvement impact Mariana's campaign?

qAndA.answer: They launched a counter-campaign using humor and absurdity to ridicule the government's anti-refugee hate campaign, encouraging people to vote 'yes' and 'no' on the referendum, thereby invalidating the results.
qAndA.question: How did the Two-Tailed Dog Party successfully invalidate the 2016 referendum?

qAndA.answer: The video starts with a neutral and informative tone but gradually shifts to a more determined and optimistic mood as Mariana emphasizes the challenges and potential for change in Hungarian politics.

text_to_speech: My name is Marianna Csinger I'm a political candidate for Jász-Nagykun-Szolnok Megye second electoral district for Magyar Kétfarkú Kutya Párt [The Hungarian Two-tailed Dog Party] My agenda is about corruption corruption is a huge problem in Hungary but unfortunately it's available for only a few people If I'm elected I'm going to make corruption legal for everybody In fact I hate migrants myself but I hate space migrants they are invisible pretty much the same way FIDESZ' migrants are [Viktor Orbán's party] because you can see no migrants here other than economical migrants coming from the Ukraine they are coming here and take away Hungarian people's jobs but as it is done legally they are taken advantage of because they are paid much less than Hungarian workers here We are currently at Jászberény railway station which is the center of my political district and we are currently in the middle of collecting signatures which would enable me to run for elections in April. We need to collect 500 signatures within two weeks and as you can see sometimes the weather is very hostile especially in February it's incredibly difficult to collect. However some people are afraid to lose their job and despite the fact that the Hungarian legislation will not enable for the governing party to see who signed these kind of sheets, some people are still afraid to support us with their signatures. And it's very difficult for us because we are sometimes sent away from parking lots of supermarkets where it should be the easiest to collect these signatures but unfortunately we are sent away The in Szeged where this party was founded MKKP was founded by Kovács Gergely who is a graphic designer this was originally a street art group but it has grown into a party so this is the first time we could run for election in Hungary In Budapest we are very well known people either love us or hate us depending on their sense of humor and depending on their political ideology I don't know if you have heard of the 2016 referendum against the migrant quota that was partly us, it was the achievement of MKKP that this election became completely invalid the government had a hate campaign against the refugees who were all victims and they were campaigning against the EU quota of migrants distributed evenly within the states of the EU and Hungary would have to host only about 1300 they had some really terrible banners saying like "these people will rape your women and they will take away your jobs" in hungarian of course and one of them was something like "if you come to Hungary you can't think was a big big success

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: My name is Mariana Tinger. I'm a political candidate for Yasnet Gonçolano,
my second electoral district for Magyar Ketvar Gugutja.
My agenda is about corruption. Corruption is a huge problem in Hungary, but
unfortunately it's available for only a few people. If I'm elected I'm going to
make corruption legal for everybody. In fact I hate migrants myself but I hate
space migrants. They are invisible pretty much the same way Fidesz's
migrants are because you can see no migrants here other than economical
migrants coming from the Ukraine. They are coming here and take away Hungarian
people's jobs but as it is done legally they are taken advantage of because
they are paid much less than Hungarian workers here. We are currently at
Yasbedin railway station which is the center of my political district and we are
currently in the middle of collecting signatures which would enable me to run
for elections in April. We need to collect 500 signatures within two weeks and
as you can see sometimes the weather is very hostile especially in February it's
incredibly difficult to collect. However some people are afraid to lose their job
and despite the fact that the Hungarian legislation will not enable for the
governing party to see who signed these kind of sheets. Some people are still
afraid to support us with their signatures and it's very difficult for us
because we are sometimes sent away from parking lots of supermarkets where it
would be easiest to collect these signatures but unfortunately we are sent away.
The owners don't have to send us away but for some reason they do. They just
realize this is the opposition candidate collecting signatures then in that
case they just send us away. So we are not doing so great but the presence of
Deepati definitely made things easier so thank you very much guys you are my
heroes. You have seen this logo with dog with two tails this used to be an
archaeological find in Sagad where this party was founded. MKKP was founded by
Kowajegerge who is a graphic designer. This was originally a street art
group but it has grown into a party so this is the first time we could run for
an action in Hungary. In Budapest we are very well known people either love us
or hate us depending on their sense of humor and depending on their political
ideology. I don't know if you have heard of the 2016 referendum against the
migrant quota that was partly us. It was the achievement of MKKP that this
election became completely invalid. The government had a hate campaign against
the refugees who were war victims and they were campaigning against the EU
quota of migrants distributed evenly within the states of the EU and Hungary
would have to host only about 1,300. They had some some really terrible
banners saying like these people will rape your women and they will take away
your jobs and in Hungarian of course and they one of them was something like if
you come to Hungary you can't take away the job of Hungarians and if you come
to Hungary you cannot. You have to respect our culture and MKKP hacked this
campaign. We made some silly posters and we involved some aliens and we
involved some very absurd figures which ridicule this whole hate campaign and
as a result of this people voted with a yes and no which made their vote
invalid and this invalidated the whole referendum so that I think was a big
success.

youtube_description:
The MKKP (Hungarian Two-tailed Dog Party) organizes the  parliamentary elections in Hungary which will be held on 8 April 2018.
Two delegates of die PARTEI from Berlin are on a support mission for the MKKP candidate Marianna Csinger in Jászberény, Hungary. The electoral campaigning help from die PARTEI will 
strengthen democracy in both countries! Hurrá!
Extended edition.
